It’s currently on sale for 29% off, making this a great time to stock up on this cleaning essential now. This vacuum has 60 minutes of runtime and is fully cordless, making it easy to clean your hardwood floors or rugs.
The Motorbar brush head is also resistant to pet hair, so you won’t have to worry about your furry friend’s hair getting tangled in it. There are three power modes, too, including a power boost mode and an eco mode, depending on how thorough a clean your space needs. There’s even a hair screw tool, which sucks up long hair and pet hair with ease.
There are four total accessories, which let you clean corners and even ceilings, plus the vacuum’s filtration system, traps 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3 microns. If you suffer with allergies, this is the vac to grab! If you’re looking for an easy-to-use vacuum that’s worth buying this Prime Day, this Dyson V11 is it. Shop it now before this deal expires.
With five accessories, including a stair tool, this vacuum is designed to deep clean your home. It even features a filtration system so allergens are not recirculated throughout your air. With a 40-minute cleaning time, three extra cleaning attachments and the ability to convert this option into a handheld vacuum, this is a great pick for small spaces. This sturdy vacuum will save you from dirt, dust and debris — and, of course, pet hair.
You’ll never have to worry about hair getting tangled in Dyson’s Motorbar brush, and the 70-minute runtime is one to beat. This handheld vacuum can clean your car’s upholstery with ease and looks good doing it, too. Plus, it’s surprisingly powerful for its compact size.
